synopsis: Chapter 6 reports that SplatAD at CVPR 2025 trains in about one hour per scene using one A100 [f4944]. The glossary repeats this training-time and hardware figure, providing a consistent cross-location claim rather than a separate benchmark [f16200, f4944]. It classifies NVIDIA A100 and A40 as data-center graphics cards, but the supplied facts give no A40 training-time comparison [f16199, f4944, f16200].

relations.note: Both report approximately one hour of SplatAD training per scene on one A100.
